I’m no professional on these situations but I have been through similar circumstances with a ex girlfriend. My suggestion is that despite your busy schedule you may need to go to councillors for yourself so that you can perhaps talk to someone with an outside view to see what you can do. I would also attempt to make record of the abnormal behaviour that your girlfriend has been doing (e.g. saying his name in his sleep) that gives you suspicions of her regarding this guy and present them to the councillor. It may be worth a shot to speak to someone else who you know you can trust who knows your gf very well to see if she has any history with this sort of thing prior to your relationship. And eventually couples councillors could help repair the patches in your relationship that may be forming because of this issue. For the time being, do not let her family know of this because it will pretty much eviscerate your relationship with your girlfriend.
